first_order_economic_incidence: BCRA result and/or remunerated monetary liabilities absorb immediate cost
second_order_bridge: Settlement/rollover can affect monetary liabilities; BCRA explicitly described endogenous issuance/quasi-fiscal channel
fiscal_or_household_caveat: Treasury deposits/fiscal flows can offset or alter monetary impact; no one-to-one taxpayer identity

immediate_counterparty_flow: Interest/devengement owed by BCRA to holder bank
first_order_economic_incidence: BCRA balance/result is immediate issuer-side incidence
second_order_bridge: Monetary/quasi-fiscal implications depend on rollover, sterilization and balance-sheet management

immediate_counterparty_flow: Coupon/indexation/principal owed by Treasury to holder
first_order_economic_incidence: Treasury debt service is direct fiscal incidence
second_order_bridge: Financing can come from taxes, new debt, cash balances or other fiscal resources
fiscal_or_household_caveat: Household incidence only indirect unless a specific tax/financing bridge is identified

immediate_counterparty_flow: No required contemporaneous issuer cash flow
first_order_economic_incidence: Counterpart is market valuation/own balance position
second_order_bridge: Future realization may involve a market buyer; recognition itself is not a Treasury/BCRA payment

trigger_or_contract: Exchange rate changes × net FX position
immediate_counterparty_flow: No required bilateral payer for accounting revaluation
first_order_economic_incidence: Incidence lies in balance-sheet exposure and underlying asset/liability holders
second_order_bridge: Underlying contracts may have depositors, firms, public sector, derivatives counterparties
fiscal_or_household_caveat: Household link cannot be inferred from aggregate FX gain

immediate_counterparty_flow: Indexed debtor/issuer owes adjusted contractual amount
first_order_economic_incidence: Depends on asset type: household mortgage, corporate loan, Treasury bond, etc.
second_order_bridge: If liability side is indexed, bank also owes depositor/funder adjustment
fiscal_or_household_caveat: Direct household link only for explicitly identified household loan balance

first_order_economic_incidence: Household bears direct contractual financing cost
second_order_bridge: Bank profit remains after funding, operating, credit-loss and tax costs
fiscal_or_household_caveat: This is a genuine direct household→bank gross-revenue channel when sector/contract is identified

immediate_counterparty_flow: Borrower fails to pay; bank provisions/recognizes loss
first_order_economic_incidence: Immediate accounting incidence is on bank capital/profit
second_order_bridge: Later recoveries/collections can change realized loss
fiscal_or_household_caveat: Not a household payment to bank; distress may transmit as bank loss

first_order_economic_incidence: Depositor receives income; bank bears funding cost
second_order_bridge: Households can sit on beneficiary side of this bank-cost channel

bank_accounting_effect: Bank recognizes purchasing-power result on monetary position
first_order_economic_incidence: Incidence internal to net monetary exposure
second_order_bridge: No direct BCRA/Treasury/household counterparty follows from the accounting line
